steps.description: COST DRIVER CORRECTED 2026-08-08; budget raised 19s -> 180s. THE PREVIOUS RATIONALE HERE WAS WRONG AND MISLEADING: it derived 19s from a COMPILE measurement, but the cold path this node actually dies on is a NETWORK FETCH. Both privileged reds on main that day (run 31283614686 @ e692a151d, run 31284978438 @ 501b787f3) failed here with one detail line -- 'Updating git submodule https://github.com/rrnewton/dynamorio.git' -- and zero 'Compiling' lines. WHY A TRIVIAL PACKAGE PAYS A HUGE COST: hermit-manifest-plan depends only on serde, serde_json, sha2 and toml, so its own compile really is the measured ~5.4s; but `cargo build -p <member>` must first MATERIALIZE every git dependency in the workspace lock, including git+https://github.com/rrnewton/reverie.git, and the reverie repo carries third-party/dynamorio as a git SUBMODULE. The first cargo invocation of the run therefore checks reverie out into $CARGO_HOME/git/checkouts and recursively fetches DynamoRIO (235 MB; measured on this box 6.3s full clone) plus sabre and e9patch. The runner blew 19s on the DynamoRIO fetch alone. BIMODAL, NOT A REGRESSION: 2f8f8e537, the commit that introduced this node, is an ANCESTOR of edae964e2, which was GREEN at this same 19s budget. The discriminator is cache state, not code. THE DECIDING CACHE IS $CARGO_HOME/git, NOT target/. Each distinct reverie pin gets its own checkout directory, so a pin bump, a cache eviction, or a different self-hosted box makes this node cold however warm target/ is. The old claim that this lane is 'structurally warmer than portable' because the self-hosted checkout persists target/ is true and IRRELEVANT -- target/ is not the cache being missed. WHY 180s, MATCHING PORTABLE: the cost is network+disk materialization of a fixed set of git dependencies, which is lane-INDEPENDENT, so the ~9x compile-speed gap between ubuntu-latest and the self-hosted boxes does not apply and both lanes should budget this node alike. Deliberately generous; the durable fix is to prefetch $CARGO_HOME/git OUTSIDE the DAG's budgeted critical path (filed separately). ARITHMETIC after the independently measured metadata correction: this node is on the critical path (setup.manifest_plan -> e2e.metadata -> build.manifest_guests -> e2e.manifest_applications), now 180+180+120+130 = 610s, so the inner launcher is 720s and the job timeout 22 minutes. Do not hand-tune any of these: ci/test_harness.sh recomputes the path and both bounds from source, so rerun `./ci/test_harness.sh validate`.
